title: Execution over concatenated gate lists
statement: Let $\beta$ be a type, let $f$ assign a value in $\beta$ to each gate and current list of values, and let $g_s,h_s$ be lists of gates and $I$ an initial list of values. Executing the concatenated gate list $g_s++h_s$ from $I$ gives the same list as first executing $g_s$ from $I$ and then executing $h_s$ from the resulting list.
